details: For the oriented one-inclusion graph of every finite concept class.
name: Maximum Degree / Maximum Positive Degree
proof: For every vertex, its number of smaller neighbours is at most its total degree.  Taking maxima over vertices gives the inequality.
witness_verification: For the family #classes/singletons_plus_empty_set with n>=4, the established endpoint values or bounds, in parameter order, are $n$ and $1$. The first parameter divided by one plus the second tends to infinity as n tends to infinity, ruling out every reverse affine-linear bound. See the database-owned value proofs for these two endpoints.
